reason: Card up front, bills on day 4 and payments are final, with zero customer results published. That reads like a trap to me. $147 is also a big chunk of what I make when I'm barely landing clients.
objection: Three days is nowhere near enough to know if cold DMs turn into booked calls, and then it bills me and I can't get it back. No one has shown results, so I'd be the guinea pig paying $147.
would_change_my_mind: A longer trial or a real refund window, plus a few real customers showing replies and booked calls, and a lower starting price around $49 to $79.
